#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long modpow(long long x, int y) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1) res = (res * x) % MOD;
        x = (x * x) % MOD;
        y >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long modinv(long long a) {
    return modpow(a, MOD - 2);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    int N;
    long long pk;
    cin >> N >> pk;

    if (pk > N - 1) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    int k = (int)pk;
    int c = N - k;

    vector<long long> fact(N + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
        fact[i] = (i * fact[i - 1]) % MOD;
    }

    auto choose = [&](int a, int b) -> long long {
        long long denom = (fact[b] * fact[a - b]) % MOD;
        return (fact[a] * modinv(denom)) % MOD;
    };

    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = c; i >= 0; --i) {
        long long term = (choose(c, i) * modpow(i, N)) % MOD;
        if ((c - i) % 2 == 0) {
            ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
        } else {
            ans = (ans - term + MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }
    ans = (ans * choose(N, c)) % MOD;
    if (k > 0) {
        ans = (2 * ans) % MOD;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;
}
